node.label: Reduced tissue palmitoyl-protein thioesterase activity
node.definition: Activity of the enzyme palmitoyl-protein thioesterase (PPT; EC 3.1.2.22) in tissues below the lower limit of normal. The activity can be measured in multiple tissues including culutured fibroblasts and leukocytes.

evidence.snippet: Ceroid lipofuscinosis, neuronal, 1: Reduced tissue palmitoyl-protein thioesterase activity (frequency 5/5) [PCS]
